items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: Who is that? Chester Lozada? [INTERVIEWER] Chester Lozada. [INTERVIEWEE] Chester Lozada. Oh.

ctx.x: You know, I was trying to think of anything else we haven't covered. Uh, you ever been in any tight jams or didn't you send you to play music that you had to run or anything? He told me, we been in some tight jams, you know, trying to run, you know.

One fella, one fella throwed a, uh, a pool ball, a cue ball at, at, at my head, you know. I asked him, who he's throwing that, he said, anybody. Anybody. Anybody go at that. That is on, uh, Claiborne and, uh, Eganya, you remember that night? Kid Sheik was playing the trumpet. Yeah. Fella thought a, a bottle of beer up there and knocked Chester Lozada on out down, you remember that night? Knocked down, down the hill a piece there. Who is that? Chester Lozada?
